sobre-mi.texto_acerdeDe: I am a developer specialized in team collaboration and implementing effective technological solutions. I have experience working both collaboratively and individually. My focus is on content management systems like WordPress and Joomla, as well as frameworks like Laravel. Additionally, I am an expert in troubleshooting IT issues and configuring email systems. I am passionate about creating websites that deliver an exceptional user experience.
